admission_coverage_incomplete.decisive_if: justify capture/export completeness for every admission stream in scope
missing_evidence: complete admission coverage for the bounded scope

admission_observation_unaccepted.decisive_if: establish provenance and acceptance for the candidate admission record

admission_presence_unknown.decisive_if: determine whether a candidate covering admission is present in the observation set

admission_requirement_not_defined.decisive_if: state the rule requiring a covering admission for this action class

alternative_route_not_established.decisive_if: establish that the tested route is genuinely outside the required enforcement point

candidate_admission_does_not_establish_a.decisive_if: supply a candidate admission that joins to the same bounded action context
missing_evidence: covering admission bound to this execution

declared_settlement_point_not_reached.decisive_if: wait for the declared deadline/settlement point before appraising the postcondition

execution_observation_unaccepted_or_miss.decisive_if: supply an independently accepted observation of the execution or effect

no_effect_observation_not_complete.decisive_if: close the downstream observation window before inferring non-occurrence

observation_window_open.decisive_if: close the interval under a stated finalization/watermark rule

protected_effect_observation_unaccepted.decisive_if: supply accepted downstream evidence for the protected effect

protected_effect_unknown.decisive_if: observe whether the protected effect occurred for the named attempt

readback_source_not_accepted.decisive_if: establish provenance/trust for the read-back source

readback_stale_or_time_unbound.decisive_if: obtain a fresh observation bound to the declared settlement interval
missing_evidence: fresh read-back in the declared window

readback_unavailable.decisive_if: obtain a read-back from the declared observation source

refusal_not_attributed_to_required_bound.decisive_if: identify the required boundary as the cause of refusal rather than inferring it from 403/no-effect

route_observation_unaccepted_or_missing.decisive_if: supply accepted evidence that the named route was actually exercised

scope_unaccepted_or_missing.decisive_if: bind the evidence to the authority, tenant, target, operation, attempt and interval

state_value_missing.decisive_if: supply both sides of the declared postcondition comparison

target_or_operation_not_bound.decisive_if: bind the route/control evidence to the same protected operation

target_or_predicate_not_bound.decisive_if: bind expected and observed state to the same target and predicate
missing_evidence: same target and declared postcondition predicate

valid_control_missing_or_incomparable.decisive_if: show the same route and operation succeeds when the tested boundary condition is absent

purpose: independent expected guidance for every inconclusive reason; the checker's own table is not used as the oracle
